release_notes:
1. Standardized module title to "E-Commerce DataLayer: GA4, Meta, Pinterest, TikTok, Google & Microsoft Ads" and resolved HTML entity double-escaping (& to &).
2. Comprehensive typography hierarchy & readability overhaul across all 6 Back Office tabs (28px title, 20-22px section headings, 15.5px labels, 15px form controls, zero text smaller than 13px).
3. High-contrast color palette eliminating washed-out grays in favor of accessible dark slates (#0f172a / #1e293b / #475569).
4. Preserved 100% Tracking Contracts: Zero DOM scraping, backend data models, and verified parameter schemas.
